summary: Plan secure, resilient cloud services for social registries and benefit systems. Review the five-day course outline and enrol.
lede: Cloud computing for social protection programs supports dependable hosting for social registries, eligibility systems and benefit services. For social protection IT leads, security specialists and program systems managers, the work includes classifying workloads, mapping data exchanges, setting access and privacy controls, and planning recovery and cost reviews. The course also covers phased transition roadmaps, while detailed cloud configuration and vendor-specific engineering remain at overview level.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape, operate or oversee cloud decisions for social registries, programme management information systems and beneficiary services. It suits intermediate learners who can relate system choices to programme operations and control requirements.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with social protection programme operations and basic information systems is expected. No coding or programming is required; exercises use architecture and control templates plus spreadsheet-based calculations.
